text: CLI lets you run API collections with simple command-line commands
quote: With Bruno CLI, you can run your API collections with ease using simple command line commands.

text: Generate test reports in JSON, JUnit, and HTML formats
quote: Generate Test Reports : Easily create reports in multiple formats, including JSON, JUnit, and HTML, to analyze and share test results.

text: Integrates with CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and validation
quote: CI/CD Integration: Effortlessly integrate with CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and validation.

text: Can serve mock responses while building an API
quote: Serve realistic mock responses while you build.

text: Native Git collaboration lets teams version-control collections directly
quote: Bruno's superpower is the ability to collaborate natively using version control systems like Git

text: Core Git UI features (init, diff, pull, clone) are free
quote: Core Git UI features (init, view diffs, check for updates, pull, clone) are now available in the free version.

text: Option to preserve scripts when importing/exporting Postman collections
quote: feat: add preserve scripts option for Postman import/export

text: No telemetry - vendor has zero visibility into user requests
quote: No cloud sync. No account. No login. We have zero visibility into your requests, and we're not training AI models on your data.

text: User data is never used to train AI models
quote: No cloud sync. No account. No login. We have zero visibility into your requests, and we're not training AI models on your data.

text: Collections are stored as plain-text Bru files directly on the filesystem
quote: Bruno stores your collections directly in a folder on your filesystem.

text: Supports global client certificates with ability to disable individual ones
quote: add global client certs and allow disabling individual client certs.

text: CLI flag to override global environment variables at runtime
quote: add --global-env-var to override global environment variables at runtime

text: Rich text editor for writing collection documentation
quote: feat(docs): Rich text docs editor

text: Drag-and-drop and alphabetical sorting for environment variables
quote: support drag-and-drop and alphabetical sorting for variables

text: Supports GCP Secret Manager as a secrets backend
quote: feat(secrets): add GCP Secret Manager support

text: Official Docker images run the CLI in CI/CD without installing Node.js/npm
quote: Official Docker images for the Bruno CLI let you run API collections in CI/CD pipelines and locally without installing Node.js or npm on the host.

text: Can open multiple collections from a monorepo
quote: open multiple collections from a monorepo

text: Docs written alongside collections can be published as shareable HTML
quote: Write docs with your collections; publish as shareable HTML.

text: Built-in GUI Git interface for init, diff, pull, commit without leaving the app
quote: Bruno's built-in Git interface — init, diff, pull, commit, and more without leaving the app.

text: Can import existing Postman collections into Bruno
quote: it also has a feature for importing your existing Postman collections to Bruno

text: Collections can be run in Docker, GitHub Actions, and other CI pipelines
quote: Run your collections in Docker, GitHub Actions, and other pipelines.

text: Pre-request and post-response JavaScript scripting with bru API, request chaining, and libraries
quote: Pre-request and post-response JavaScript — the `bru` API, request chaining, and libraries.

text: Write assertions/test suites and automate data-driven test runs
quote: Write assertions and test suites, and automate runs with data-driven testing.

text: Secret variables and vault integrations keep credentials out of version control
quote: Keep credentials out of version control with secret variables and vaults.

text: Azure CLI session can authenticate to Azure Key Vault without manual credential entry
quote: Azure CLI authentication feature allows you to authenticate with Azure Key Vault using your existing Azure CLI session, without requiring manual entry of Tenant ID, Client ID, or Client Secret in Bruno.

text: Automatically generates Akamai EdgeGrid signature and Authorization header for requests
quote: Bruno generates the EdgeGrid signature and attaches the required `Authorization` header automatically.

text: Supports OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials grant type for authenticating requests
quote: Select `OAuth 2.0` as the authentication method and set the grant type to `Client Credentials`.

text: Ghost-text AI suggestions appear while writing pre-request/post-response/test scripts
quote: Ghost-text suggestions appear as you type in Pre-Request, Post-Response, and Tests script editors.

text: AI icon in Scripts tab generates a script from a natural-language description
quote: Open the Scripts tab on any request, folder, or collection. Click the AI icon, describe what you need, and Bruno generates a script.

text: Bruno AI is Bring-Your-Own-Key; no user data routed through Bruno's servers
quote: Bruno AI uses a Bring Your Own Key model. You connect your own provider account and Bruno uses it directly. No data is routed through Bruno servers.

text: AI Chat Sidebar gives assistance anywhere in the workspace without opening a request first
quote: The AI Chat Sidebar lets you ask questions and get AI assistance directly from anywhere in your workspace, without needing to open a specific request first.

text: Can generate full Bruno collections (requests, tests, docs) from backend source code
quote: Generate Bruno collections – Create API collections from your backend source code with requests, tests, and documentation.

text: AI can generate a complete working custom App from an open request/collection's context
quote: Bruno AI understands the context of your open request or collection and can generate a complete working App for you. You don't need to write a single line of HTML or JavaScript.

text: Custom UIs can be built with HTML/CSS/JS or React that interact with your APIs inside Bruno
quote: Build custom UIs with HTML/CSS/JS or React that interact with your APIs inside Bruno.

text: Bruno runs fully offline with no cloud sync, ever
quote: Bruno is offline-only. There are no plans to add cloud-sync to Bruno, ever.

text: AI can generate test code in the Tests tab from a natural-language description
quote: Open the Tests tab, click the AI icon, and describe what to assert. Bruno generates test code that you can review before accepting.

text: AI can write endpoint/workflow documentation in the Docs tab for review
quote: Open the Docs tab, click the AI icon, and describe the endpoint or workflow. Bruno writes the documentation for you to review and accept.

text: Can connect to any OpenAI-compatible provider, including self-hosted/local models like Ollama or LM Studio
quote: Bruno can connect to any provider that exposes an OpenAI-compatible API. This includes third-party hosted providers, company gateways and proxies, self-hosted inference servers, and local model applications such as Ollama or LM Studio.

text: Users can type natural-language questions/requests (e.g. setting up OAuth2 or writing a test)
quote: Type your question or describe what you need (for example: "How do I set up OAuth2 for my collection?" or "Write a test that checks the response time is under 500ms.").

text: Can configure Cursor to automate API development workflows against Bruno
quote: With Bruno's local-first approach you can configure Cursor to automate your API development workflow.

text: VS Code Copilot can be configured to use Bruno as an AI agent
quote: VS Code has built-in GitHub Copilot support for AI code completion and you can configure it to use Bruno as your AI agent.

text: AGENTS.md file lets Codex understand how to generate/work with Bruno collections
quote: you can add an `AGENTS.md` at your project root so Codex understands how to generate and work with Bruno collections.

text: Ultimate Edition lets License Administrators govern which AI providers/models are allowed org-wide
quote: On **Ultimate Edition** subscriptions, License Administrators can govern Bruno AI across the organization, controlling which providers and models are allowed and how requests are protected.

text: Default Safe Mode restricts scripting; Developer Mode flag re-enables npm packages and filesystem access
quote: the default runtime mode has changed from **Developer Mode** to **Safe Mode** for improved security. If you need to use Developer Mode features (external npm packages, filesystem access), you must explicitly pass the `--sandbox=developer` f

text: Requests and collections can be used without leaving your code editor
quote: Requests and collections without leaving your editor.
